g.text: Six product surfaces failed, and two of themdegraded rather than stopped
HTTP 5xx status codes returned to end users.
Significantly elevated HTTP 5xx errors, as requests to the KVfront-end gateway failed with the core proxy.
Widespread authentication failures until the rollback was initiatedat 13:05; existing sessions unaffected, failed attempts returned an error page.
Mostly operational, but most users could not log in becauseTurnstile was unavailable on the login page.

Processing and delivery unaffected. Temporary loss of an IP reputationsource reduced spam-detection accuracy and prevented some new-domain-agedetections; some Auto Move actions failed, all reviewed and remediated.

Response latency also rose across the CDN during the impact window: debugging and observability systems consumed largeamounts of CPU automatically enriching uncaught errors with additional debugging information.
Cloudflare, “Cloudflare outage on November 18, 2025”, impact table. All times UTC.
